comment: mklev.c level_finalize_topology() copies rtype into orig_rtype for every slot of svr.rooms[], including the subrooms. The Oracle's Delphi is a subroom of oracle.lua's centre room, and dungeon.c recalc_mapseen() reads its orig_rtype to add 'Oracle of Delphi.' to #overview. A debug-mode Valkyrie level-teleports to depth 5, where seed 71832 places the Oracle, maps the level with #wizmap so room_discovered() marks the Delphi seen, then opens #overview. The seed, clock and character were chosen for this case.
